faq.title: Common Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about MasterLeadFlow

items.q: How does MasterLeadFlow find jobs for me?
items.a: Our AI watches your WhatsApp groups 24/7. It reads every message, identifies real job requests, and sends you only the ones that match your trade and county.

items.q: Can I add my own WhatsApp groups?
items.a: Yes — that's how it works. Share your group invite links, we join within 24 hours, and our AI starts scanning them for you.

items.q: Will people in my group know I'm using this?
items.a: No. We never post, comment, or interact in your groups. We only read messages silently and send matching leads to you privately. Nobody will ever know.

items.q: How fast do I get notified?
items.a: Right away. The moment a job that fits you is posted, you get a WhatsApp message with all the details. Be the first to respond.

items.q: What can Rebeca do for me?
items.a: Rebeca is your AI assistant on WhatsApp. Ask her to check your stats, pause leads, update your trades, or give feedback on a lead — all without leaving WhatsApp.

items.q: What if I can't take a job?
items.a: Forward it to other contractors via Rebeca. You earn commission on every forwarded job that gets completed. Everyone wins.

items.q: What if I don't get any leads?
items.a: If you don't receive a matching lead in your first 7 days, we'll extend your trial. We only win when you win.
About 2 minutes. Pick your trade, set your area, and share your group links. Jobs start coming in right away.

problem.subtitle: Every day, contractors send money and trust to people they've never met. Here's what goes wrong.

card1.title: No Information
card1.desc: You give a job to someone you don't know. No reviews. No history. Just a phone number from a WhatsApp group.
card1.reply: Is he any good? Anyone worked with him?
card1.tag: No reviews · No rating · No verification

card2.title: No Control
card2.desc: They stop answering. They do bad work. They take the money and disappear. You have no way to protect yourself.
card2.name: Tony Ramos

card3.title: Both Sides Lose
card3.desc: Your sub also takes a risk. They do the work, but sometimes don't get paid. Without trust — everyone loses.
card3.tag: No contract · No proof · No protection
